description: Full details for a specific bike listing on Cyclesite: specs, condition, frame number presence, photos, delivery, seller's city. Takes the URL slug from a listing result. Example: 'tell me more about that 2022 Trek Domane'. The marketplace is not the seller: contact goes through the route in `howToContactSeller`, delivery terms are only what `delivery.summary` states, and no seller has agreed a price or delivery through this tool.
name: get_listing_detail
title: Get listing detail
